description: Brimbank Drinking Fountains is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Brimbank City Council. Open Space asset features collected as part of the Open Space Inventory & Condition Assessment project. This layer contains point features for outdoor Drinking Fountains. While all due care has been taken to ensure the dataset is accurate and current, there may be errors or omissions in it. Coverage: Brimbank City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Brimbank City Council. Its tags are Location, Society, drinkingfountain, open space, park. It offers 4 resource(s) in esri shapefile - zipped, geojson, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 Australia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
